# Hijab Sourcing

> Jersey and modal hijab fabric manufacturer offering OEM and ODM production
> from a single mill in Shaoxing, China. Knitting, dyeing, finishing, cutting,
> labelling and retail packaging are handled in-house.

## What the company does

Hijab Sourcing supplies hijab fabric and finished hijabs to brands and
wholesalers. Buyers choose a base fabric, specify a weight in GSM, submit a
colour reference for lab-dip matching, and optionally add their own woven
labels, hang tags and retail packaging. Output ships either as roll goods for
the customer's own cutting and sewing, or as finished pieces cut, hemmed,
labelled and retail-packed under the customer's brand.

## Key facts

- Founded: 2015
- Location: 3F, Building 1, Anqiaotou Village, Sunduan Street, Yuecheng
  District, Shaoxing, Zhejiang Province, China
- Workforce: about 120 staff
- Facility: approximately 8,000 square metres
- Monthly capacity: about 500,000 pieces
- Production lead time: about 30 days from approved sample to finished goods
  (sampling and lab dips happen before this clock starts)
- Base fabrics: 13, across jersey and modal
- Weight range: 60 to 240 GSM; every base runs across a weight band rather
  than a single fixed weight
- Certifications: OEKO-TEX Standard 100, BSCI
- Business model: OEM and ODM

## Fabric range

Jersey collection and modal collection, 13 base fabrics in total. The modal
collection includes 30s Modal, 40s Modal, 50s Modal, Lenzing Modal, Tencel
Modal, Bamboo Modal and Twill Modal. Each base has its own working weight
band inside the overall 60-240 GSM range.

Weight guidance used on the site:
- 60-80 GSM: ultra-light, gossamer sheer and translucent
- 80-110 GSM: light, airy and semi-sheer
- 110-150 GSM: all-season, opaque with balanced drape
- 150-180 GSM: medium-heavy, structured drape with defined folds
- 180-240 GSM: winter weight, dense and warm with deep folds

## Colour matching

Customers send a physical swatch, a hex value or a colour reference from an
existing supplier. The mill produces three lab dips against that reference and
the customer approves one on real fabric before bulk dyeing begins.

## Branding and packaging

Woven labels, care labels, hang tags, thank-you cards, retail sleeves and
rigid gift boxes are produced in-house.

## Export markets

United States, Canada, United Kingdom, European Union, United Arab Emirates,
Oman, Australia, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia.

## Quality control

Per-batch checks cover weight against the target GSM band, colourfastness
(rubbing and perspiration), shrinkage after laundering, and verification of
label placement and packaging against the approved sample.

## Minimum order quantity

MOQ depends on the base fabric and on whether the shade comes from the stock
range or a custom lab dip; stock shades start considerably lower than custom
ones. The mill quotes an exact minimum per enquiry rather than publishing a
single headline figure.
